space_configuration.title: Interactive Floor Plan Editor
space_configuration.description: Draw and modify your space's outline directly on the floor plan. Tap or click lines to add vertices, drag points to adjust measurements, and double tap or click a vertex to delete it. The scale and total area update automatically in real-time.

roomType.title: What space or type of product are you interested in optimizing?
roomType.description: Tell us which area of your home or project you want to transform. We will show you ideas and products designed to fit your needs.

1.title: Kitchen
1.description: Organize, decorate and optimize every corner: from modular cabinets to lighting and storage solutions.

2.title: Bathroom
2.description: Turn your bathroom into a functional and relaxing space, with combinations that balance comfort and aesthetics.

3.title: Other
3.description: Select this option if you are looking for solutions for another type of space or want a more open recommendation.

budget.title: What is your approximate budget range?
budget.description: Select the range that comes closest to your planned investment. We will help you find products that balance quality and cost.

1.title: Under $12,000 MXN
1.description: Small changes with great impact. Ideal for accessories or accent details.

2.title: Between $15,000 and $20,000 MXN
2.description: Balanced options to renovate entire areas without compromising style.

3.title: Over $25,000 MXN
3.description: Comprehensive transformations with premium materials and custom designs.

style.title: What style do you prefer?
style.description: Your style defines the character of the space. Choose the one that best reflects your personality and way of living.

1.title: Classic
1.description: Elegant shapes, symmetry and noble materials that never go out of style.

2.title: Modern
2.description: Clean lines, smooth surfaces and an aesthetic focused on functionality.

3.title: Contemporary
3.description: Balance between trend and timelessness, with a versatile and dynamic approach.

4.title: Minimalist
4.description: Less is more: clear spaces and visual harmony with a touch of calm.

5.title: Industrial
5.description: Exposed textures, metals and wood in contrast for a bold and urban personality.

color.title: What color palette do you prefer?
color.description: The tones you choose will determine the atmosphere of the space. Select according to the feeling you want to project.

1.title: Light tones
1.description: Visually expand spaces and provide a feeling of brightness and calm.

2.title: Dark tones
2.description: Transmit elegance, depth and character. Perfect for sophisticated environments.

3.title: Neutrals and naturals
3.description: Soft combinations that harmonize with any style and highlight the texture of materials.

materials.title: What materials do you prefer?
materials.description: Select the materials that best align with your style and desired maintenance.

1.title: Wood and stone
1.description: Warm and natural finishes that add texture and a homely feel.

2.title: Metal and glass
2.description: Modern combination, ideal for clean designs and high durability.

3.title: Laminates or composites
3.description: Practical, resistant and with multiple visual finishes for customization.

space_size.title: How is your family composed?
space_size.description: Select the option that best describes the people living in the home. This will help us estimate the ideal space size and the amount of furniture needed.

1.title: Single
1.description: Compact, functional, and easy-to-maintain spaces. Prioritizes multifunctional design, vertical storage, and integrated areas.

2.title: Couple or couple with pet
2.description: Medium size, with shared and flexible areas. Requires comfortable, modular furniture capable of adapting to different lifestyles.

3.title: Family with children
3.description: Ample spaces with well-defined zones for socializing, resting, and storage. Durable materials and furniture resistant to daily use are recommended.

4.title: Extended family or shared housing
4.description: Large surface area, with multiple common areas and high foot traffic. Ideal for integrating large-capacity furniture and smart organization solutions.

header.title: Customizable furniture online
header.description: Design, customize and order your furniture online, ready to be manufactured on demand by specialized workshops.

generate.title: Generate your set
generate.description: Our system analyzes your preferences and available space to automatically create an initial design proposal. Get a set tailored to you in seconds.

adjust.title: Customize online
adjust.description: Modify materials, colors and distribution directly from the 3D configurator. Every change updates your set in real time with smart suggestions.

preview.title: Preview your space
preview.description: Explore an interactive view of the final design. You will see measurements, combinations and optimized recommendations according to your family profile and space usage.

reserve.title: Reserve or request advice
reserve.description: Save your configuration, request a quote or schedule a consultation with our team to fine-tune final details before production.

kitchen.title: Integral kitchens
kitchen.description: Modular and functional designs that optimize your space. Each integral kitchen is custom-made, with customizable materials and distribution options adapted to your lifestyle.

bathroom.title: Complete bathrooms
bathroom.description: Ready-to-install bathroom sets, combining furniture, sinks and accessories in a single aesthetic proposal. Customize finishes, colors and measurements according to your needs.

policies.title: Privacy Notice
policies.content:
Dear clients and visitors of {empresa}:

At {empresa} we understand the importance of protecting the personal data of our clients and visitors (hereinafter “The Holders”), which is why we commit to handle it lawfully, confidentially, and in compliance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties and other applicable regulations.

DATA CONTROLLER
{empresaLegal}, located at {domicilioEmpresa}, is responsible for collecting, using, and protecting the personal data of The Holders.

CONSENT OF THE HOLDER
It will be considered that The Holders have granted their consent if they do not expressly object to this Notice.

PERSONAL DATA SUBJECT TO PROCESSING
We may collect data such as: full name, email, phone number, address, RFC (for invoicing), payment details, as well as access information to {sitioWeb}. We do not collect sensitive data unless strictly necessary for the provision of services.

PURPOSES OF THE PROCESSING
The data may be used for:
1) Provision of services and commercialization of {empresa} products.
2) Creation and administration of accounts in {sitioWeb}.
3) Processing of orders, payments, and invoicing.
4) Customer service (complaints, inquiries, returns).
5) Compliance with legal obligations.

Secondarily, we may use the data to send promotions, surveys, event invitations, and advertising related to {empresa}.

DATA TRANSFER
The data may be shared with:
- Business partners and authorized providers for service provision.
- Banking institutions to process payments.
- Competent authorities when required by law.

ARCO RIGHTS
The Holders may exercise their rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Opposition (ARCO) by sending an email to {correoDatosPersonales}.

MODIFICATIONS
{empresa} may modify this Notice at any time. Updates will be published on {sitioWeb}.

CONTACT
📧 {correoDatosPersonales}
📍 {domicilioEmpresa}
